# op: W write value (mask ff) · M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | value · D delay, value = ms (RD nominal; RD's real sleeps were longer) · P poll until (reg & mask) == value · R read, value = traced (informative) · X step described in hdmi-it6805.md (§ in note)
# dev: 8-bit I2C address on bus 1 (90 IT6805, e0 IT6805 sub-block). bank: bank in effect (reg 0x0f[2:0]); * = the bank register itself; - = not banked. All numbers hex except D values (decimal ms).

# RD = reference driver. Values are what RD wrote. R rows are informative reads; RD also read most registers before writing them (omitted). RD's repeated selects of an already selected bank are omitted: the bank column gives the bank in effect.
